verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a public REST API with create, read, update and delete operations over JSON and standard HTTP verbs, versioned /wp-json/wc/v3/ endpoints, scoped read/write API keys, official JavaScript/PHP/Python/Ruby libraries, and a separate public Store API for cart and checkout. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API. This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format
Choose the level of access for this REST API key, which can be Read access, Write access or Read/Write access.
all endpoints are versioned under the /wp-json/wc/v3/ prefix (e.g. GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products)
Official libraries: JavaScript Library, PHP Library, Python Library, Ruby Library
The Store API provides public Rest API endpoints for the development of customer-facing cart, checkout, and product functionality.
